question: Who initiated the project that led to PDF?
answer: The project that led to PDF was initiated by Adobe co‑founder **John Warnock**.

There are several predefined encodings, including WinAnsi, MacRoman, and many encodings for East Asian languages and a font can have its own built-in encoding. (Although the WinAnsi and MacRoman encodings are derived from the historical properties of the Windows and Macintosh operating systems, fonts using these encodings work equally well on any platform.)
